```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens;
use Spatie\Uuids\HasUuids;

class User extends Authenticatable implements HasApiTokens, Notifiable
{
    use HasApiTokens, Notifiable, HasFactory, HasUuids;

    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'email',
        'password',
        'is_active',
        'profile_picture',
        // Add other fields based on your user model requirements
    ];

    // Additional methods and relationships can be added here

    public function posts()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Post::class);
    }
}
```
